thread.element: fridge icon that empties, then re-fills sorted

copy.headline: Every Sunday, open your fridge. Pull everything out.
copy.body: You'll be surprised what you find.

copy.headline: This takes 10 minutes. Group everything into three piles.

quadrants.label: Freeze Now
quadrants.value: Save what you won't reach in time

copy.headline: The "Use Today" pile becomes tonight's meal
copy.body: Don't plan around a recipe - plan around what needs to be eaten.

copy.headline: The "Freeze Now" pile takes 5 minutes.
copy.body: Bag it, label it, lay it flat.

copy.headline: Less food waste and money saved every year, for 10 minutes on Sunday.
The best kitchen habit isn't a recipe. It's seeing what you have before you decide what to buy.
copy.ctaLine: fond does the audit for you, every day.
